final: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT m.major_id, m.department, COUNT(mem.member_id) AS member_count FROM major AS m JOIN member AS mem ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.major_id, m.department), shares AS (SELECT major_id, department, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM major_counts), ranked AS (SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS department_avg FROM shares) SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, share - department_avg AS above_department_average FROM ranked WHERE share > department_avg ORDER BY above_department_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10.
